svg.aria-label: Exploded isometric drawing of the Macintosh Mini build, front to back: the Maclock's front shell with the floppy slot that works the power switch, the 3D-printed screen bezel, the Waveshare 2.8-inch display, the GPIO interposer that plugs in between the display and the Pi, the Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W with the Macintosh Mini board upright beneath it, and the Maclock's back shell with its 18650 cell lying in the base
